title: KTAE：token 级优势估计账（correct/wrong 列联表 + Fisher/IG/BM25-tf/arcsine-Cohen 四信号融合 key token 权重 + 组内标准化回报的 eos 融合）
title_en: KTAE: Token-Level Advantage Ledger (Correct/Wrong Contingency Table + Fisher/IG/BM25-tf/arcsine-Cohen Signal Fusion into Key-Token Weights + EOS-Fused Group-Standardized Outcome)
source_lines: verl/workers/actor/compute_key_tokens.py 全文件（compute_Cohen / fisher_exact_test / calculate_ig / compute_tf / get_distribution / compute_key_tokens / get_key_tokens）+ verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py::compute_ktae_outcome_advantage_and_keytokens（L155-236）
description: KTAE 的核心主张：outcome reward 只在序列级打分，把奖励回传到 token 的方式应该由数据本身决定——统计「哪些 token 的出现与答题对错相关」，把这些 key token 位置的 advantage 显著放大。官方 verl 实现的确定性账（vLLM/日志剥除，responses/mask/rewards/index 全入参），八入口复刻：distribution——token id → 出现该 token 的独立行数（unique rows，非频次）；appear_table——correct（reward>0）/wrong（≤0）两组，每 token 一行 2×2 列联表 [组内出现数, 对组出现数, 组内未出现数, 对组未出现数]，cc+wc==0 的行保持 0；fisher——超几何精确检验 p 值的 lgamma 数值逼近（k 网格 [max(0,R1+C1−n), min(R1,C1)]、p_k≤p_obs 掩码累加），格式化 exp(−2p) 且 p==1 压 0；ig——「对错」关于「token 是否出现」的信息增益（log2、safe_log(x>0)、条件熵 total>0 门、t_n==0 行清 0）；tf——BM25 风格饱和词频（k1=2.0、b=0.5、avg_len=(总correct token数+总wrong token数)/2）；cohen——组内出现率 clamp[0,1] 后 arcsine−sqrt 距离；key_tokens——result=((α·fisher_fmt+β·ig)·x)/(α+β)（γ_tf 时 x 加 tf 差项 tf0/(tf1+1e-5)−tf1/(tf0+1e-5)），→(sigmoid−0.5)·2·top，**硬编码 result[151643]=0**（表大小 max_token_num+1、官方调用方传 responses.max().item()，小词表时该行 IndexError）；advantage——按 index 分组（numpy 值 hash），单条组 mean 0/std 1/零权重表（大小 responses.max() 无 +1——含全局最大 token id 的单条组 IndexError），多条组 torch.std（unbiased）+ 全 α=β=γ=top=1 的 key token 表，scores=(s−mean)/(std+1e-6) 后 tile×eos_mask + 按 token id 索引的权重×eos_mask 相加。
description_en: KTAE's core claim: outcome rewards score whole sequences, so how credit reaches tokens should be decided by the data itself — find tokens whose presence correlates with answer correctness and amplify their advantage. This problem replicates the deterministic accounting of the official verl implementation (vLLM/logging stripped; responses/mask/rewards/index fully parameterized) via eight solve entries: distribution — token id → number of distinct rows containing it (unique rows, not frequency); appear_table — correct (reward>0) vs wrong (≤0) pools, a per-token 2x2 contingency row [in-group count, cross-group count, in-group absence, cross-group absence], rows with cc+wc==0 stay 0; fisher — Fisher exact p-values via a lgamma numeric approximation (k-grid [max(0,R1+C1−n), min(R1,C1)], masked accumulation of p_k ≤ p_obs), formatted as exp(−2p) with p==1 squashed to 0; ig — information gain of correctness given token presence (log2, safe_log(x>0), conditional entropy gated on total>0, zero rows where t_n==0); tf — BM25-saturated term frequencies (k1=2.0, b=0.5, avg_len=(total correct tokens+total wrong tokens)/2); cohen — arcsine−sqrt distance of clamped in-group rates; key_tokens — result=((α·fisher_fmt+β·ig)·x)/(α+β) (with γ_tf, x gains the tf difference tf0/(tf1+1e-5)−tf1/(tf0+1e-5)), then (sigmoid−0.5)·2·top, with the **hardcoded result[151643]=0** (table sized max_token_num+1 where the official caller passes responses.max().item(); small vocabs raise IndexError on that line); advantage — group by index (numpy value hashing), single-row groups get mean 0/std 1/zero weight table sized responses.max() (no +1 — a single-row group containing the global max token id raises IndexError), multi-row groups use torch.std (unbiased) plus a key-token table with all α=β=γ=top=1, and after scores=(s−mean)/(std+1e-6) the result is tile×eos_mask + token-id-indexed weights×eos_mask summed.
notes: 官方账的关键细节（沙箱实测钉死）：(1) **表大小语义**：key token 表 = max_token_num+1，官方 advantage 调用方传 responses.max().item()——表按「最大 token id」开不是词表大小；硬编码 result[151643]=0（Qwen 特殊 token 清零）要求表 ≥151644，小词表 fixture 直接 IndexError（原生 bug，钉死为用例）。(2) **单条组零表大小 = responses.max()（无 +1）**：与多行组（+1）不一致——单条组行恰含全局最大 token id 时必 IndexError；这也是官方怪癖，用 mixed-single fixture 钉死。(3) get_distribution 数的是**独立行数**（unique rows per token）不是出现频次——列联表的「组内出现数」是行数口径。(4) fisher 检验是数值逼近：log_comb 用 lgamma、p 值 = Σ p_k（p_k≤p_obs 且在支撑 [k_min,k_max] 内），p==1 → exp(−2p) 项压 0；token 12（两组频率同 [2,1;2,1] vs [1,1;3,2] 的对称）p=0.4 → exp(−0.8)≈0.4493 是唯一非零格式化信号。(5) ig 的方向：token 11 只在 correct 组出现 → H(Y|X) 下降 → IG 大；16-21/151644 只在 wrong 组 → 同样 IG>0；12 两组对称出现 → IG 小但非零（0.0817 的 10/13 是 mixed）。(6) key token 的符号由 x（Cohen 差，correct 率−wrong 率的 arcsine）决定：correct 独占 → +1 饱和、wrong 独占 → −1、频率同 → Cohen=0 → 权重 0（sigmoid(0)−0.5=0）。(7) advantage 的融合是**加法**不是乘法：标准化回报 tile + 权重，都乘 eos_mask；空 correct 或空 wrong 组 → key token 全 0 → 退化为纯 GRPO 标准化。(8) index 按**值** hash（官方传 numpy array）——torch tensor 作 dict key 是对象身份 hash 会 KeyError。(9) average_weight_by_mask_tensor 是官方死代码（定义未调用），不入题。与 to-grpo-advantage 划界：GRPO 只做组内标准化回报，KTAE 在其上叠加数据驱动的 token 级权重（无价值网、无 GAE，纯统计账）。
notes_en: Key official details (pinned by sandbox runs): (1) **Table sizing**: the key-token table is max_token_num+1 where the official advantage caller passes responses.max().item() — the table spans max token id, not vocab size; the hardcoded result[151643]=0 (zeroing the Qwen special token) requires the table to reach 151644, and small-vocab fixtures raise IndexError right there (a native bug, pinned as a test case). (2) **Single-row groups allocate their zero table as responses.max() (no +1)** — inconsistent with multi-row groups (+1); a single-row group whose row contains the global max token id always raises IndexError, also pinned via a mixed-single fixture. (3) get_distribution counts **distinct rows** (unique rows per token), not frequencies — the contingency table's in-group count is a row-count metric. (4) The Fisher test is numeric: log_comb via lgamma, p = Σ p_k over the support [k_min, k_max] where p_k ≤ p_obs; p==1 squashes the exp(−2p) term to 0; token 12 (symmetric frequencies) has p=0.4 → exp(−0.8)≈0.4493, the only nonzero formatted signal. (5) IG direction: token 11 appears only in the correct group → H(Y|X) drops → large IG; 16-21/151644 only in the wrong group → also IG>0; symmetric token 12 → small-but-nonzero IG (10/13 are the 0.0817 mixed ones). (6) The key-token sign comes from x (the Cohen difference, correct-rate minus wrong-rate in arcsine space): correct-only → +1 saturation, wrong-only → −1, equal frequencies → Cohen=0 → weight 0 (sigmoid(0)−0.5=0). (7) The advantage fusion is **additive**, not multiplicative: standardized outcome tile + weights, both masked by eos_mask; an empty correct or wrong group → all-zero key tokens → pure GRPO standardization. (8) index hashes **by value** (the official trainer passes a numpy array) — torch tensors hash by object identity and would KeyError the id2* dicts. (9) average_weight_by_mask_tensor is official dead code (defined, never called) and stays out of the problem. Boundary vs to-grpo-advantage: GRPO only group-standardizes the outcome; KTAE stacks data-driven per-token weights on top (no value network, no GAE — a pure statistical ledger).
